candidates: When deprecating a function in JSDoc, always link to the replacement using `{@link ReplacementFunction}` syntax inside the `@deprecated` tag (e.g., `/** @deprecated Use {@link getBoundaries} instead */`), so IDEs and documentation tools can resolve the reference.

When updating the CSpell configuration, ensure the top-level `language` setting includes both `en-US` and `en-GB` (e.g., `language: en-US,en-GB`) so that both American and British English spellings are accepted project-wide without requiring per-file `cspell:locale` overrides.

Do not silently correct apparent typos in jison `%options` directives. A misspelled option name is effectively a no-op, but changing it to the correct spelling can inadvertently enable a feature (some jison options are enabled by default in certain implementations). Either delete the questionable option entirely, or suppress the spell-check warning with a `// cspell: disable-line` comment and leave the original text unchanged, noting why it must stay misspelled.
